name: PCP4NbS Public Support Grants
summary: Public Support Grants for Philippine organisations sustaining public support for nature-based solutions for climate adaptation, especially in PCP4NbS priority areas and project sites.

deadline.text: on or before 5:00 pm (Philippine Time) on November 23, 2026

status.quote: We are now calling for Public Support Grants for initiatives that will sustain public support for Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for climate adaptation. Apply by November 23, 2026!

deadline.quote: All proposals shall be uploaded and submitted through the Grants Portal on or before 5:00 pm (Philippine Time) on November 23, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Entities eligible to receive funds under the Program include: Non-government organizations (NGOs) Organized, registered, and/or recognized community-based organizations, people's organizations (POs), indigenous peoples' organizations (IPOs), and/or women's rights organizations (WROs)

geography.quote: Eligible organizations in other areas across the Philippines may also be supported, provided they demonstrably contribute to strengthening the implementation and sustainability of ongoing NbS initiatives

access.quote: Ready to submit your proposal? APPLY THROUGH GRANT PORTAL

window.quote: Have a project in mind? Read the Request for Proposals and apply before November 23, 2026.

amount.quote: Public Support Grants may be between PhP 1,000,000 to PhP 2,000,000, with an implementation period of up to 8 months starting in February 2027 onwards.
